transcript.answer: The gate stopped wrapping each tool executor on 2026-09-29. PR #291, "Run the oversight gate on the engine's beforeToolCall hook", was merged at 13:35:47 UTC that day. It deleted the per-executor `withHumanOversight` wrapper and un-wrapped the registrations in `registerTools.ts`. The wrapper had been introduced earlier, in PR #280 (merged 2026-09-28, fixing #33). I did not read the PR #291 diff itself. The deletion is taken from #193's description, PR #291's description and the spec.
